text: DSH Jiuwen Adapter 是 Cordis 插件，为 DSH 注册 jiuwen 模型提供方，默认经 WebSocket 把对话交给 JiuwenSwarm Gateway。它支持 Gateway 对话流、会话映射和 /jiuwen 命令，也提供 OpenAI 兼容模式。用户可查询或切换模型与模式，并管理会话。适合想在 DSH 中使用 Jiuwen agent 或 swarm 的用户。需要可访问的 JiuwenSwarm Gateway；OpenAI 兼容模式可配置 API key。

DSH Jiuwen Adapter registers a jiuwen provider for DSH and routes turns to JiuwenSwarm Gateway over WebSocket. It supports streamed replies, persistent session mapping, and /jiuwen commands for models, modes, and sessions. An OpenAI-compatible mode is also available. A reachable Gateway is required.

DSH Jiuwen Adapter 的功能「Gateway 对话」：通过 WebSocket 将 DSH 回合发送给 Jiuwen Gateway，并将回复转换为 DSH 输出。
DSH Jiuwen Adapter 的功能「OpenAI 兼容传输」：在配置选择兼容模式时，通过 chat completions 请求并解析 SSE 或 JSON 响应。。通过 Gateway 传输或 DSH 命令触发。
DSH Jiuwen Adapter 的功能「会话连续性」：为 DSH 会话保存对应的 Jiuwen 会话 ID，并持久化映射及每会话选项。。通过 Gateway 传输或 DSH 命令触发。
DSH Jiuwen Adapter 的功能「Jiuwen 命令」：通过 /jiuwen 子命令查询状态和模型，并可设置当前会话的模型或模式。。通过 Gateway 传输或 DSH 命令触发。

@dsh-jiuwen/adapter README · Introduction：A Cordis plugin that registers a `jiuwen` provider on `ctx.llm`. dsh still handles the UI, sessions, approvals and plugins. Each turn goes to the [JiuwenSwarm](https://pypi.org/project/workswarm/) Gateway, which runs its own agents, tools and memory.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  D["dsh + your plugins"] -->|ctx.llm · provider=jiuwen| A["jiuwen adapter"] -->|"WS chat.send"| G["JiuwenSwarm Gateway :19000"]
```

- Plugin compatibility: [docs/plugin-compat.md](docs/plugin-compat.md)

@dsh-jiuwen/adapter README · Features：| | What you get | Default |
|---|---|---|
| 🧠 **Jiuwen brain** | One dsh turn is one Gateway `chat.send`. Agents, team mode, skills and memory run in Jiuwen | on |
| 💬 **Live activity** | Reasoning, 🔧 tool calls, subtasks and token usage stream into dsh | on |
| ✅ **dsh approvals and questions** | Jiuwen permission prompts, plan approval and `ask_user` go through dsh's own dialogs, and deny when no answer comes | on |
| 🔁 **Session continuity** | dsh sessions map to Jiuwen sessions. Only new text is sent after the first turn | on |
| 🛟 **Drop recovery** | If the Gateway drops mid-answer, the reply is recovered from history and marked as recovered | on |
| 🧾 **Local titles and compaction** | Titles and `/compact` are handled locally, so they never cost a Jiuwen turn | on |
| ⌨️ **`/jiuwen` command** | Sessions, models, modes, skills, agents, cron, MCP and more ([list](./docs/dsh-integration.md#5-jiuwen-slash-command-dsh-command-registry)) | on |
| 🖼️ **Multimodal** | Image and file parts are sent as Jiuwen media | on |
| 🪪 **System prompt → Jiuwen** | `injectSystem: full\|persona` sends the host system prompt (any role/profile) once per Jiuwen

@dsh-jiuwen/adapter README · Compatibility：Other dsh plugins must keep working. The adapter is tested against the **full dsh agent runtime** (`dsh-agent`, `dsh-agent-loop`, compaction, subagents, goals, plan mode, a bash sandbox, approvals and user-questions). The same scripted session runs once with jiuwen loaded and once without. Every row of the [compat matrix](./docs/known-issues.md#15-round-8-full-runtime-scenarios--version-matrix) must match, covering events, tool calls, plan exit, goal rounds, auto-compaction, subagents, bash, host event counts, globals and load failures.

@dsh-jiuwen/adapter README · Compatibility：| Component | Supported | Tested in CI |
|---|---|---|
| dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` | 0.2.1-rc.2, 0.2.1-rc.5 |
| Cordis | `^4.0.5` | 4.0.5 |
| Node | `>=22` | 22, 24 |
| JiuwenSwarm | 0.2.x Gateway | 0.2.7 (live) |

The adapter also works in any Cordis app that has an `llm` service ([usage](./docs/usage.md)).
